verdict.rationale: Vanta's API product page says you can bulk-assign owners to resources, mark them out of scope, or offboard employees in batches (vanta-docs-23), and the API reference says the API is for automating bulk actions (vanta-docs-58). However, every endpoint shown in the pack acts on a single item (create or update one control, upload one contract at 10 requests/minute), so bulk work appears to be scripted loops rather than native batch operations. missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API endpoints, evidence that the MCP server or AI agent can run bulk operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
